key_insight: HADRec improves drug recommendation by combining patient EHR text with molecular drug information and ATC hierarchy-aware prediction.
clinical_relevance: This could support safer, more accurate medication suggestions by aligning recommendations with both pharmacology and standardized clinical drug categories.
method: Encodes clinical notes with LLaMA-7B and drug SMILES with ChemBERTa
Fuses patient and drug features using cross-attention
Adds a hierarchy-aware predictor plus consistency loss to enforce ATC logic
evidence_signal: On MIMIC-III, HADRec achieved state-of-the-art Jaccard, F1, and PR-AUC, and it generalized well to MIMIC-IV with good calibration (ECE = 0.04, Brier = 0.06).
watch_item: Performance is strong on retrospective benchmarks, but real-world deployment would still need prospective validation and careful handling of shifting clinical workflows.
paper_title: HADRec: A Hierarchy-Aware Drug Recommendation Framework by Fusing Molecular Knowledge and Electronic Health Record
